card.name: Second digit inside fixed numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second digit of a multi-digit number, such as an address number, phone number, edition number or price. It is most common in reference-style text like addresses, hotline numbers and citations.

modes.label: Phone and address digits
modes.description: Second digit in a street number or toll-free phone number.
modes.example: Inc., 5<<1>> Franklin Street, Fifth Floor, Boston,

modes.label: Edition numbers
modes.description: Second digit of an edition number just before "th ed." in a citation.
modes.example: eds. Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics. 1<<8>>th ed. Philadelphia, Pa: Saunders

modes.label: Prices and codes
modes.description: A digit inside a price or classification code.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digit of a number such as a phone number, street address or edition number.
